## Bio

Isaac is an undergraduate student in Information Technology and holds a degree in Ecology from the Federal University of Rio Grande do Norte. He is developing software engineering skills with an emphasis on technological tools that help address societal challenges, bringing a social and environmental perspective from his training in ecology.
